field_semantics.drive_window_seconds: Elapsed time from each drive start state to its end state; separately reported from summed per-play possession clock.
field_semantics.fourth_down_attempts: Scrimmage plays that began on fourth down; punts and field-goal attempts are excluded from go-for-it attempts.
field_semantics.lineup_player_snaps: Modeled RB/FB/WR/TE lineup appearances only; QB and linemen excluded and production chosen independently.
field_semantics.observed_overtime_touchdowns: Offensive touchdowns on observed overtime drives without play or player attribution.
field_semantics.offensive_success_rate: Down-based success: at least 40% of yards-to-go on first down, 60% on second, chains on third/fourth; touchdowns count as successful plays.
field_semantics.other_score_points: Non-touchdown, non-safety score-ledger points, including field goals.
field_semantics.possession_seconds: Sum of recorded per-play game-clock intervals while this team had possession; reconciled separately with drive windows and kickoff clock time.
field_semantics.red_zone_field_goals: Made field goals; alias of red_zone_field_goals_made.
field_semantics.snaps: Starting QB: team scrimmage plays. RB, FB, WR, TE: lineup-model count. Null for linemen and defenders, which are not modeled.
field_semantics.starter: Frozen depth-chart role, not evidence of playing time.
field_semantics.targets: Assigned receivers on pass attempts; throwaways and spikes are not modeled, so targets generally equal attempts.
field_semantics.third_down_attempts: Scrimmage plays that began on third down; conversions require a same-possession transition to a new first down.
field_semantics.try_points: Touchdown drive ledger points above six, not a count of try attempts.

player_note: Participants are selected from the frozen pregame roster before the outcome. qb, receiver, rusher outcome rows are reweighted by cutoff-safe player distributions before the game-state transition. Box-score passing, receiving and rushing yards use their corresponding nflverse fields when present; the state transition uses yards_gained. This is a research projection layer; historical source outcomes and the current model do not establish calibrated forecasts.

quarter_by_quarter.player_stats_scope: players_with_period_activity; omitted roster players have zero period stats

realism.lineup_semantics: player_snaps counts modeled RB/FB/WR/TE lineup appearances only, not full player snaps; production is selected independently.
